title: Personal Checking: refunding an extended overdraft fee charged in error
content:
## Scope

This rule decides the refund of the most recently posted extended overdraft fee on a Personal Checking account once its bank-error grounds have been judged.

## Formal clauses

1. **Grounds.** The fee is a bank error when the debit that opened its negative episode is identified and would have been paid by a transfer from the linked savings account, or when the fee was charged at an amount other than the tier's extended overdraft fee. Either ground alone suffices.
2. **Never twice.** A fee that already has a refund entry is never refunded again.
3. **Refund owed.** When the fee is a bank error and has no refund yet, it is refunded in full, never in part, at that fee's own amount, as a bank-error refund.
4. **Otherwise nothing.** Otherwise this review refunds nothing, and a goodwill request is decided under the courtesy gates of the general Personal Checking fee refund rules.
5. **No rounding.** Fee amounts carry 2 decimal places, so the refund needs no rounding.

## Truth table

| Opening debit identified and would have been paid by a transfer | Fee at an amount other than the tier's figure | Fee already has a refund entry | This review |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | No | Refund the fee's own amount in full |
| No, or not identified | Yes | No | Refund the fee's own amount in full |
| Yes | Yes | No | Refund the fee's own amount in full, once |
| No, or not identified | No | No | Nothing; a goodwill request goes to the courtesy gates |
| Any | Any | Yes | Nothing |

## Witness case (hypothetical figures)

A hypothetical tier's extended overdraft fee is 18.00 USD and the fee posted at 30.00 USD with no refund yet. A reader might refund only the 12.00 USD overcharge, or the tier's 18.00 USD. The clause refunds the fee in full at its own amount: **30.00 USD**.

## Points of judgement

- **Wrong reading:** "the extended overdraft fee is refunded together with the overdraft item fee that opened the episode". **Correct basis:** the refund this review decides is the refund of the reviewed extended overdraft fee alone, at that fee's own amount.
